title: VK-only Read Discrete Inputs field interaction
purpose: Vary unit identifier, starting address and quantity together to exercise field interactions in the discrete-input parser and reply path.
expected_behavior: The server should recognize a valid Read Discrete Inputs request and produce a normal response containing the requested nine input states or a protocol-level exception if the address is unsupported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches the request PDU size.
Unit identifier 02, function code 02, address 0020 and quantity 0009 are encoded consistently.
Hex is lowercase with no separators.
issue_safety_notes: The candidate preserves the issue-related focus on server request handling without using the documented packet bytes or relying on the speculative pointer-cause description.
